ModMetaData.name: RimExodus — Seamless World Dev
ModMetaData.author: Laurence-042
ModMetaData.description:
告别"撤离地图 → 世界地图 → 重新加载"的割裂旅行。RimExodus 让相邻世界地块的局部地图在视觉与操作上连续连接：你的殖民者可以从基地门口直接走进荒野，穿过一条看不见的世界地块边界继续走向下一片荒野——不需要远行队，不需要加载画面。
主要特性： · 直接跨图行走——殖民者跨过两图接缝几乎无感切换到相邻地图； · 跨图战斗——跨缝视线/索敌与弹道交接，子弹飞过接缝在正确的地图上命中正确的目标（可整体关闭回到原版战斗语义）； · 分帧增量生成——邻居地块在殖民者被命令靠近边界时开始生成，通常不暂停游戏、无加载画面； · 地图滚动休眠——远离的地图自动休眠（内容完好保留），更远的删除、再访时重新生成（重新生成是全新的，遗留物品与建筑会丢失）；家园永不休眠/删除； · 原生内容接入——派系据点、远古机械师建筑群、埋伏等 POI 走近时经原版管线生成为无缝地块； · 据点贸易商——友好据点指定贸易商，右键对话交易，完整原版远行队交易语义但无需组队。
⚠ 本 mod 仍在开发中，对地图机制改动较深，请做好遇到 bug 的心理准备。当前支持在移除 mod 前，通过设置界面的"恢复原版兼容模式"按钮将地图设置为兼容原版模式：设置为兼容后存档即可卸载 mod。不带 mod 再次加载存档会出现一次性的红字，不影响游玩，再次存档读档后就会消失。但受限于地图生成机制，仍然会有一些限制，详情请参考讨论区的帖子"关于卸载"。
Say goodbye to the disjointed "exit map as caravan → world map → reload" travel loop. RimExodus stitches the local maps of adjacent world tiles together, visually and functionally: your colonists can walk straight out of the base gate into the wilderness, cross an invisible world-tile border, and keep going — no caravan, no loading screen.
Key features: · Seamless cross-map walking — colonists cross a map seam and switch to the adjacent map with barely a hitch; · Cross-map combat — line of sight, target acquisition, and projectile handoff across seams; bullets fly over the seam and hit the right target on the right map (can be disabled to restore vanilla combat semantics); · Incremental frame-sliced generation — neighbor tile maps generate as colonists are ordered toward the border, usually without pausing the game or a loading screen; · Rolling map dormancy — far maps go dormant (contents fully preserved); even farther maps are deleted and regenerated on revisit (regeneration is fresh — left-behind items and buildings are lost); the home map is never dormant or deleted; · Native content integration — faction settlements, ancient mechanitor compounds, ambushes and other POIs generate as seamless tiles through the vanilla pipeline as you approach; · Settlement traders — friendly settlements designate a trader; right-click to talk and trade, full vanilla caravan trading semantics minus the caravan.
⚠ This mod is still in development and makes deep changes to the map system — be mentally prepared for bugs. Before removing it, use the "Restore vanilla compatibility" button in the mod settings to convert your maps; save after converting, then uninstall. Loading that save without the mod shows one-time red errors — harmless, and gone after one more save/load cycle. Some map-generation-related limitations remain; see the "About uninstalling" post in the discussions.
